sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, List of Answers on Topics 15

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, List of Answers on Topics 15:1
items.html: They are direct light and reflected light. For the light of the look that is received, that is, in the first three phases —

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, List of Answers on Topics 15:2
items.html: Hochma, Bina and Tifferet — is “the phase of direct light” in it. And the light of the look that is not received, but is rejected backward, that is, the light that is fit for phase four, is “the phase of reflected light” in it. (Chapter 12, Item 3)
